content_sections.heading: Nirmal AWT Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details (AWC-wise)
content_sections.text: 4 ICDS Projects 89 Anganwadi Centers (AWT vacant) 0 AWH Vacancies in this Phase Every one of the 89 Anganwadi Centers (AWCs) listed below has a vacant AWT (Anganwadi Teacher) post; none has an AWH (Anganwadi Helper) vacancy in this notification. Each post carries a specific reservation category as notified for that AWC. Category codes are reproduced exactly as printed in the official vacancy list (SC/ST/BC-A/B/C/D/E/OC/EWS/EX-S/HH/VH and sub-group markers such as SC-G-I/II/III); the notification does not spell out the full form of every code, so they are presented as issued rather than expanded. Note: Applicants should identify the AWC ID/AWC Name relevant to their local Gram Panchayat/ward and apply only for the post matching that center’s reserved category (see Eligibility & Locality Rules below). The number of posts/vacancies may vary; the District Collector reserves the right to amend or cancel this notification.

content_sections.heading: Nirmal AWT Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: For AWT posts, the applicant must be a local resident of the concerned Anganwadi Center’s area: if the AWC is in an urban area, she must reside in that ward/range; if in a rural area, she must reside in the Gram Panchayat where the AWC is located. For AWT posts in an ICDS sub-plan area allotted under the SC sub-plan, only SC applicants belonging to the specific village/habitation to which the post belongs are eligible to apply. For AWT posts in an ICDS sub-plan area allotted under the ST sub-plan, only ST applicants from villages within that Gram Panchayat are eligible to apply.

rows.details: Only women applicants are eligible for Anganwadi Teacher posts
Applicant must not be less than Intermediate (12th class) pass

content_sections.heading: Nirmal AWT Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: Not specified in the notification: No separate age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/PwD/Widow/Ex-Servicemen categories is mentioned; the notification states a single 18–35 age band applicable to all applicants.

content_sections.heading: Nirmal AWT Recruitment 2026 Pay / Honorarium
content_sections.text: Not specified in the official notification: No honorarium/salary figure for the Anganwadi Teacher post is mentioned in either the notification or the vacancy list. Candidates should check the Department’s website or contact the local ICDS Project office for current honorarium details.

content_sections.heading: Nirmal AWT Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: There is no written examination. Selection of candidates is based on the following criteria, as assessed by the District-level Selection Committee: Note: The notification does not state whether the special-category marks (Widows/Orphans/PwD) are added on top of the 70+10=80 base or are alternative/mutually exclusive; it is presented here exactly as listed in the source.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Nirmal AWT Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official website wdcw.tg.nic.in . Check the vacancy list to identify an Anganwadi Center in your local Gram Panchayat/ward where you are eligible to apply (matching the notified reservation category). Complete and submit the online application between 15 September 2026 and 30 September 2026, up to 5:00 PM. Retain a copy/acknowledgement of your submitted application. Note: The notification also states that applications submitted through CDPO/DWO offices or via Prajavani will be taken into consideration in the counting, alongside the primary instruction to apply only through the wdcw.tg.nic.in website. Candidates should confirm with the local CDPO/DWO office if they intend to use an offline route.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Not specified in the official notification: A specific list of documents to upload/produce is not given. Based on the eligibility and selection criteria stated, applicants are likely to need: Intermediate marks memo/certificate, proof of date of birth, residence/locality proof (ward or Gram Panchayat), category certificate (SC/ST/BC/EWS as applicable), and, where claimed, a Widow/Orphan/Disability certificate.

content_sections.heading: Important Conditions
content_sections.text: Only eligible local women candidates, resident in the AWC’s notified area (ward/Gram Panchayat), may apply for a given AWT post. For AWT posts under SC or ST ICDS sub-plan areas, eligibility is further restricted to SC or ST candidates respectively from the specific village/habitation or Gram Panchayat concerned. The District Collector/Chairman, District-level Selection Committee, Nirmal, has full authority to completely cancel this notification or make any necessary changes to it. Applications submitted via CDPO/DWO offices or Prajavani will also be taken into account in the process, in addition to online applications through wdcw.tg.nic.in.

faq.question: Q1. How many Anganwadi Teacher posts are available in Nirmal district?
faq.answer: 89 AWT posts are vacant across the Bhainsa, Khanapur, Mudhole and Nirmal ICDS Projects, to be filled in the first phase per Notification No. A/255/2026 dated 11.09.2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Online applications close on 30 September 2026 at 5:00 PM; the window opened on 15 September 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Who is eligible to apply?
faq.answer: Only women candidates who are Intermediate (12th) pass, aged 18–35 years as on 1 July 2026, and who are local residents of the specific AWC’s ward or Gram Panchayat.

faq.question: Q4. Is there a written exam?
faq.answer: No. Selection is based on Intermediate marks (70), special-category marks for Widows/Orphans/PwD (5/10/5), and a District Selection Committee interview (10).

faq.question: Q5. Can I apply for any Anganwadi Center I like?
faq.answer: No. You may only apply for the AWC in your own ward (urban) or Gram Panchayat (rural), and, for SC/ST sub-plan area posts, only if you belong to the SC/ST category and to the specific village/habitation concerned.
